errors.claim: Usage: 'each participant simultaneously shows a fist or up to five fingers.'
errors.searches: rg -i 'fist of five', 'simultaneous', 'holding up a fist'
errors.source_check: Source line 1191: 'each person communicates their level or agreement or support by holding up a fist or up to five fingers.' Two-or-fewer-fingers -> discuss/revise/revote to chosen threshold matches lines 1213-1215. But 'simultaneously' is an added procedural detail not in the source.

errors.claim: Scrum Master 'accountable for establishing Scrum and keeping the team's focus on its process.'
errors.source_check: Line 693: 'accountable for establishing Scrum as defined in the Scrum Guide' (faithful). Line 707: 'The Scrum Master's focus is process.' Note reframes 'the SM's focus is process' into agentive 'keeping the team's focus on its process' - a gloss beyond what the source states.

errors.claim: Nonfunctional quality-attribute example: 'Response time must be a few seconds or less in all operating environments.'
errors.source_check: Line 1853: 'Response time should be a few seconds or less in all operating environments.' Note substitutes modal 'must' for source's 'should' - small strength change in an otherwise verbatim example.

errors.claim: Visibility: '+ marks public members, - marks private members, # marks protected members.'
errors.source_check: Lines 2494-2495: 'The + indicates a public method, - is private, and # is protected.' Source annotates methods; note generalizes to 'members'. Standard-correct UML but a broadening beyond the source text.

errors.claim: Multiplicity: 'a label such as 0..1, 1, or 0..* that states how many instances may participate at an end of an association.'
errors.searches: rg '0..1', '0..*', -i 'multiplicity', 'zero or one', 'zero or more', 'exactly one'
errors.source_check: Concept supported by figure notes (2526 'zero or one instances', 2541 'zero or more instances'/'exactly one instance'). Literal notation 0..1/1/0..* lives only in figure images, not the converted text; note supplies correct standard notation matching the source's verbal descriptions but not verifiable in-text.

errors.claim: Inheritance: 'a line with a hollow triangular arrowhead pointing to the superclass; source is a subclass and is a target-class instance.'
errors.source_check: Line 2550: 'Class2 is a subclass of Class1; Class2 is a Class1' - relationship faithful. 'hollow triangular arrowhead pointing to the superclass' is standard UML shown only in Figure 4.10 (image); 'hollow'/'triangular'/'arrowhead' return zero hits in the source text.
